d:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?
I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
p: Welcome back, adventurer. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
c:
These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, friend.
Try these on and take one you'd like in trade.

d:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.
I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by friend! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.
Good find!
p: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
c:
What's this you've got...
Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.
You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.
We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.

d:
The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.
It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
p: How goes your campaign in the Darkspear Islands, friend?
c:
You've distinguished yourself honorably in battle at the Darkspear Islands and your efforts have not gone unnoticed.
There are ever more battles to fight, however. Continue to prove yourself in battle and you will surely reap the rewards.

p: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, friend. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!
c:
Excellent work, adventurer! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory.
For the Alliance!
